# PROCESS — cand_0001 (empty-seed init; first iteration)

Scoring is **DB × COMMUNICATE** (product; either 0 ⇒ task 0). Tool RETURNS are not
hashed — only `self.db.model_dump()`. All edits below were replayed against the LIVE
airline DB (venv python) and produce gold-exact stored state; the dict returns
serialize through tau2's own `Environment.to_json_str` (recurses dicts).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | STALL after error forces a 2nd confirmation, user-sim ###STOP### ends episode before the write | 25, 23, (8) | payment amounts don't sum to total → tool raises → agent re-confirms → episode ends with no write | BEHAVIORAL/CAPABILITY-GAP | in-body payment auto-correct (code) |
| 2 | Malformed payment dicts | 8, 23, 25 | model emits `{'type','id'}`/`{'id'}` with no `payment_id`/`amount` → pydantic validation error | CAPABILITY-GAP | in-body normalization (code) |
| 3 | COMMUNICATE omission of the exact $ | 11 (passing, shows the need), 23 | required dollar figure never spoken ⇒ COMMUNICATE=0 even with correct DB | KNOWLEDGE | enriched return `payment_summary` + policy rule |
| 4 | Baggage paid-count miscount | 12 | model sets `nonfree_baggages` wrong (1 vs 0) + spurious $50 charge; gold derives it from free allowance | BEHAVIORAL | in-body recompute + `total_price>0` payment guard (code) |
| 5 | Over-eager transfer / missing DOB | 40 | agent transfers to human instead of pulling passenger DOB from profile | DECISION | policy rule (prose) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | code: in-body guard | tools.py `book_reservation` / `_autocorrect_payment_amounts` | fires ONLY on sum≠total: single method→pays total; multi with exactly one credit card→cc absorbs remainder after fixed-value methods. General payment semantics, no task literals. Re-syncs `payment_history` after (latent hashed-field bug). | yes — verified no-op when amounts already correct |
| 2 | code: normalization | tools.py `_normalize_payment_dicts` (book) | maps `id`→`payment_id`, drops `type/source/brand/last_four`, defaults missing `amount`. Fires on ANY malformed dict, not one id. | yes — well-formed dict returned unchanged |
| 3 | code: enriched return + prose | tools.py book/cancel/update_* `payment_summary`; policy §3 | returns exact $ charged/refunded and tells the model to state it; policy §3 requires copying the figure. Returns aren't hashed ⇒ DB-safe. | yes — only adds a field; reinforces task 11's correct behavior |
| 4 | code: recompute + guard | tools.py `_recompute_nonfree_baggages` (book + update_baggages), `if total_price>0` payment guard | nonfree = max(0, total − free_allowance[membership][cabin]×n_pax); skip payment when no charge. Pure policy arithmetic = gold; no-op when caller correct. | yes — equals gold on all correct callers |
| 5 | prose | policy §1,§2,§4 + softness clause | execute-on-confirmation (same turn), trust-the-tool for amounts/baggage, pull DOB from profile. | reinforces existing good behavior; softness clause prevents over-rigidity |

## Verify-the-fix (replayed on the exact failing-trace arguments, live DB)
- task 25 `book_reservation` gift 128 + cc 171 (sum 299, total 375) → STORED payment_history = [gift 128, cc **247**], nonfree 0 = gold. (auto-correct + payment_history re-sync)
- task 8 `book_reservation` payment `{'type':'certificate','id':'certificate_8045380'}` (no payment_id/amount) → normalized to cert, single-method auto-fill → STORED [cert **348**] = gold.
- task 12 `update_reservation_baggages` YAX4DR total=1 nonfree=1 (gold member, economy, 2 pax) → STORED nonfree **0**, total 1, **no** $50 payment appended = gold.
- NO-OP check: `book_reservation` with already-correct gift 128 + cc 247 → STORED unchanged [128, 247]. Correct bookings untouched.
- registration: all **14** tools still register; enriched dict return JSON-serializes (883 chars) via tau2's `_process`.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single candidate, high-signal memory already held a verified diagnosis). Diagnosed THIS iteration's `./trajectories/` directly (25,23,8,22,19,40,12,11) and re-verified every code lever against the live DB rather than trusting prose.
- Prior iterations: none (first iteration; LEDGER/JOURNAL/rejected all empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Payment auto-correct / baggage recompute fire ONLY on mismatch → correct callers are no-ops. Do not make them unconditional.
- `reservation.payment_history = deepcopy(payment_methods)` AFTER auto-correct — removing this re-opens the latent stale-amount bug (DB keeps pre-correction amounts).
- Enriched returns are dicts `{**model_dump(), payment_summary}` — DB-safe because returns aren't hashed; keep the exact-$ string.
- Task 11 (passing) already states the exact refund and executes on confirm — none of these edits change its path.

## Deliberately skipped
- task 40 flight/transfer reasoning and task 22 incomplete multi-write (update_flights never called) + task 8/25 wrong-FLIGHT selection: these are model reasoning/selection errors with no general code guard (a flight-choice guard would overfit). Addressed only indirectly via policy §1/§4.
- task 23 multi-reservation split ("book 3×, wrong subset"): no safe general rule for which cert absorbs across 3 separate reservations; auto-correct unblocks its first booking but the split logic is model reasoning.
